indications:
Brimonidine tartrate/timolol maleate ophthalmic solution 0.2%/0.5% is indicated for the reduction of elevated intraocular pressure (IOP) in patients with glaucoma or ocular hypertension who require adjunctive or replacement therapy due to inadequately controlled IOP.
                     The IOP-lowering of brimonidine tartrate/timolol maleate ophthalmic solution dosed twice a day was slightly less than that seen with the concomitant administration of 0.5% timolol maleate ophthalmic solution dosed twice a day and 0.2% brimonidine tartrate ophthalmic solution dosed three times per day.
contraindications: The recommended dosage is one drop in the affected eye(s) twice daily approximately 12 hours apart. If more than one topical ophthalmic product is to be used, the different products should be instilled at least 5 minutes apart.
warningsAndPrecautions:
Brimonidine tartrate/timolol maleate 0.2%/0.5% ophthalmic solution is supplied sterile, in white opaque plastic LDPE bottles and tips, with dark blue high density polyethylene (HDPE) caps as follows:
                  
                  
                  5 mL in 10 mL bottle           NDC 72603-931-05 10 mL in 10 mL bottle         NDC 72603-931-10
                  
                  
                     Storage: Store at 20°-25°C (68°-77°F) [See USP Controlled Room Temperature]. Protect from light. Replace the cap after use.
adverseReactions: Bronchial asthma, a history of bronchial asthma, severe chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. ( 4.1 , 5.1 , 5.3 ) Sinus bradycardia, atrioventricular block, overt cardiac failure, cardiogenic shock. ( 4.2 , 5.2 ) Neonates and infants (pediatric patients younger than 2 years old). ( 4.3 ) Hypersensitivity to any component of this product. ( 4.4 )
name: Brimonidine tartrate and Timolol maleate
